From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: Dedicated capacity fit / Acme Retail

Thanks again for the time today, Daniel and Aisha — great conversation. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so everyone's aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Pain points you described
- Latency & tail spikes: p95/p99 spikes during marketing campaigns and checkout that are impacting conversion.
- Unpredictable throughput: baseline ~50 TPS for chat/autocomplete but periodic bursts up to ~350 TPS (Black Friday-style peaks).
- Multi-tenant concerns & data isolation: need guaranteed isolation for customer PII workloads and SOC 2 evidence for audit.
- Cost predictability: current spend on shared endpoints varies widely; finance needs predictable monthly capacity commitments.

Current stack & constraints
- In-house LLM endpoints on GKE using a mix of A100 and T4 nodes; operator-maintained autoscaling is reactive and slow to warm KV caches.
- Model: using a 13B open model for chat & reranking; token mix is ~70% context + 30% generated.
- Existing auth and logging hooks (S3 logs, internal SIEM) — but you need KMS integration and audit logs surfaced for SOC 2 scope.

Success criteria for a Dedicated POC
- Maintain p95 latency <= 200ms and p99 latency <= 400ms at baseline 50 TPS.
- Handle burst up to 350 TPS with fallbacks and max acceptable degradation defined (graceful queueing / model fallback).
- Dedicated GPU pools and network isolation (VPC peering) with customer-managed KMS.
- Clear cost estimate for committed capacity + expected burst overage pricing.

Recommended next steps (we agreed on these on the call)
1) I will send a short Dedicated proposal + sizing sheet (attached).
2) You'll share a 24-hour sample of traffic and a short list of audit evidences required for SOC 2 scoping.
3) If sizing looks good: schedule a 4-week POC with dedicated pool and a basic workload replay.

Action items
- Marissa (me): attach proposal & preliminary sizing — DONE (PDF attached).
- Daniel / Aisha: share sample traffic CSV and SOC 2 evidence checklist by EOD Friday 3/13.
- Logan: follow up on SRE/SE alignment and POC kickoff calendar invite.

Attachments: 20260310-Acme-Dedicated-Proposal.pdf (proposal + sizing), acme_workload_snapshot-03082026.csv (sample token/time distribution)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — that matches what we discussed. A few quick clarifications and confirmations: 

1) Burst handling: our SRE wants to understand how KV cache warm-up will be handled during sudden bursts. Can you include expected cold-start behavior and any recommended pre-warming approaches in the sizing doc?

2) Cost: finance needs committed-monthly cost + example overage charges for a 2x burst scenario. If you can include 3 pricing bands (baseline, 2x, 6x peak) that'd be ideal.

3) SOC2: I'll attach the evidence list separately but we need encryption-at-rest with customer KMS and access logs with 12-month retention.

We'll send the 24-hour traffic sample by Friday. For the POC timeline: if we can start approvals this month, we'd like the POC to run mid-April.
